name: Gym Builder – Class Timetable & Booking for Gyms, Fitness & Yoga Studios
author: WP Dreamers

sections.description:
Gym Builder is the all-in-one WordPress plugin for gym, fitness studio, yoga centre, CrossFit box, and personal training websites. Manage class schedules, trainer profiles, member registrations, pricing packages, fitness calculators, and online bookings — all from a clean WordPress admin, with shortcodes and templates that work with any theme.

👉 Live Demo | Documentation | Get Pro Bundle | Get Pro Add-ons 👈

Whether you teach yoga, run a 24/7 gym, manage a CrossFit box, or coach 1-on-1 personal training, Gym Builder lets you set up your weekly timetable, let visitors register for a class right from the timetable (free — no add-on needed), manage trainers + members, show membership packages, and grow your fitness business — without touching a line of code.

⭐ Why Choose Gym Builder?

  • Ready in about a minute — a short setup wizard asks what you teach, then builds your classes, trainers, pricing plans, a timetable page and a pricing page for you (sample or your own), so you start with a working site instead of an empty one
  • Free class registration — visitors register for a class straight from the timetable, see how many places are left, and pick a plan; no paid add-on needed
  • Built for fitness businesses — every field, taxonomy, and workflow is purpose-built for class/trainer/member operations, not a generic booking plugin
  • Works with any WordPress theme — Astra, Hello Elementor, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Kadence, Twenty Twenty-Four, Twenty Twenty-Five, and most block themes
  • No-code admin — modern React-based dashboards; no developer required
  • Speaks your members’ language out of the box — ready-made translations for Italian, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Spanish and Mexican Spanish, across the free plugin and every Pro add-on; switch your site language and the whole suite follows, with no translation work at all
  • Lightweight & fast — optimized for site performance, minimal frontend asset load
  • GDPR-friendly — member data stays on your site, nothing sent to third parties unless you opt in
  • Theme-overridable templates — override any frontend template by placing a file in your-theme/gym-builder/

🎯 Core Features

🏋️ Class Management

  • Unlimited gym, fitness, or yoga classes via custom post type
  • Class categories with custom taxonomy
  • Weekly schedule with day + time slots + per-slot booking capacity
  • 12-hour or 24-hour time format toggle
  • Class single page + archive page with adjustable layouts
  • Class slider (Swiper-powered with autoplay, effects, pagination, navigation)
  • Multiple class layout shortcodes — grid, slider, routine
  • Class scheduling calendar with visual day/time picker

👨‍🏫 Trainer Management

  • Detailed trainer profiles with bio, skills, qualifications, social links
  • Trainer categories
  • Trainer archive + single pages with layout settings
  • Trainer assignment to classes
  • Trainer Skill Options with progress bars
  • Multiple trainer layout shortcodes

👥 Member Management

  • In-house member database (separate table, not stored in WP users)
  • Add, edit, and delete members from a React-powered admin UI
  • Auto-create WordPress user account + send login credentials by email
  • Printable member ID cards — front and back at real card size, with your logo, brand colours, the member’s photo, plan and dates, and a barcode of the member ID that any USB scanner reads
  • Member status workflow (active / inactive)
  • Membership duration tracking with start/end dates, or no end date for open-ended memberships
  • Members can join several classes, each on its own day and time
  • Members can hold several plans at once — each shown with its dates on their dashboard and in admin
  • Membership renewal reminder emails and automatic lapse when a membership ends
  • “Expiring soon” / “Expired” filters, bulk activate / deactivate / extend, and private staff notes per member
  • Specific-schedule booking from admin and student dashboard
  • Custom user roles — gym_builder_student and gym_builder_trainer

💰 Pricing Plans & Membership Packages

  • Pricing plan custom post type with category taxonomy
  • Pricing tables via the [membership_package_shortcode] with type tabs
  • Per-class pricing info
  • Currency settings — code, symbol, position (left/right)
  • Featured packages and category filtering
  • Package price modifier filter for add-ons

🧮 Fitness Calculators

  • BMI Calculator — body mass index
  • Body Fat Calculator — body fat percentage
  • Water Intake Calculator — daily hydration goal
  • Protein Intake Calculator — daily protein need
  • All four embeddable via [gbfitness_calculator id="123"] shortcode
  • Input field validation built in

👤 User Dashboards

  • Student dashboard — bookings, profile, subscriptions (with add-ons)
  • Trainer dashboard — assigned classes, sessions, and bookings (with add-ons)
  • Both dashboards extensible via tabs from Gym Builder add-on plugins

🔐 Login & Registration

  • Trainer login system
  • Student login system
  • Front-end registration forms
  • Auto-credentials email on member creation

📅 Free Class Registration & Scheduling

  • Register from the timetable — a Register button on every class slot, with “N spots left” or “Class full”
  • Visitors enter name, email and phone and become a pending member with a login; the gym activates them
  • Choose a plan — the plans that include the class are listed with their prices (e.g. “$30 / month”); classes no plan covers register without one
  • Logged-in members add classes to their own membership, within their plan’s classes, class count and end date
  • Picking a plan a member doesn’t hold yet becomes a plan request the gym approves or dismisses
  • Spam protection (nonce, honeypot, time check, rate limits) and confirmation emails to the member and the gym
  • Class times follow your 12/24-hour setting
  • Schedule table layouts
  • Per-slot capacity tracking with race-safe seat booking
  • Seat counts adjust automatically when members are added, edited or deleted

🔄 Export / Import

  • Demo data import for instant site setup
  • Export classes, trainers and pricing plans (JSON or CSV) for migration

🔌 Shortcodes

  • [gbclass id="123"] — class display (grid / slider / routine)
  • [gbtrainer id="123"] — trainer display (multiple layouts)
  • [gbfitness_calculator id="123"] — BMI, body fat, water, protein
  • [membership_package_shortcode] — pricing plans with type tabs

🎨 Theme Compatibility & Styling

  • Override any plugin template via your-theme/gym-builder/ directory (WooCommerce-style)
  • CSS custom properties — --gym-builder-primary-color (default #005dd0), --gym-builder-secondary-color
  • Responsive design optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Compatible with both classic and block themes

🚀 Pro Add-ons & Themes

Everything above is free. When you are ready to take money, track who turns up, or build pages faster, each add-on plugs straight into the classes, plans and members you have already set up — install only the ones you need, or take the whole Pro Bundle. Every add-on below ships the same seven ready-made languages as the free plugin, so adding one never leaves an English patch in a translated site.

🤖 Pro Add-ons — Running the Studio

🤖 GB AI Agent
Run the gym by chatting. Ask it to create a trainer, add a class with its weekly timetable, build a membership package and its class-access rules, enrol or deactivate a member, or free up seats — it checks capacity against the real schedule before it books anything. It configures Stripe for you (keys, billing intervals, prices, and the push to Stripe), assembles a draft Elementor page from section presets or imports a niche template, and pulls reports on the fly: today’s classes, members, expiring memberships, overdue payments, revenue, attendance, personal sessions and workout engagement — exportable as PDF, Word or Excel. It also emails members for you (renewal reminders, or a nudge to the ones who stopped logging workouts), sends you a weekly digest, and answers “how do I…” questions from the family’s own documentation with the exact admin path. Anything destructive asks for confirmation first, nothing changes until you approve it, and every action it takes is listed in an activity log.

Needs WordPress 7.0 or newer — it is built on the WordPress Abilities API and AI Client — plus an AI provider plugin (OpenAI, Anthropic or Google) with your own API key under Settings → AI.

💰 Pro Add-ons — Getting Paid

💳 GB Stripe Payments
Stripe Checkout for your membership packages. Five billing intervals — monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, yearly and one-time — with the buyer choosing their class day and time at checkout and seat capacity checked before the payment goes through. Webhook automation activates the membership the moment payment clears, keeps member status in sync on renewal, failure and cancellation, supports several subscriptions per user, and clears stale states with a daily cron. Subscriptions admin screen with CSV export.

🏦 GB Offline & Manual Payments
Card is not how every studio gets paid. The customer picks “Bank transfer” or “Pay at the studio” at checkout, sees your payment instructions and a reference to quote, and their class place is held while they pay. The order waits in a queue in your admin; when the money arrives you approve it and the membership activates exactly as a card payment would. Covers plans bought from the pricing table, payments recorded by hand at reception, personal session bookings and registrations taken through the popup. Runs alongside GB Stripe Payments, so the same plan can be paid either way.

🎁 GB Promotions & Trials
Coupons, discount codes and free trials for your memberships. Percentage or fixed discounts with usage limits, expiry dates and per-plan targeting, plus an analytics dashboard showing redemptions, discount given, revenue driven and which member used which code. Gateway-neutral by design — Stripe today, with PayPal and Razorpay ready behind a documented interface.

📆 Pro Add-ons — Bookings & Attendance

🗓️ GB Personal Session
One-to-one private training alongside your group classes. Calendar-based slot management with bulk scheduling, a multi-step booking widget (trainer → date → time → details → pay), guest booking with no WordPress account needed, Stripe payment, twice-daily email reminders, refunds at a configurable percentage, trainer reviews with manual or automatic approval, Google Calendar sync, CSV export, and a full status workflow (pending → confirmed → completed, plus cancelled and no-show). Adds its own tabs to both the member and trainer dashboards.

📊 GB Attendance System
Check members in from the admin screen or let them check themselves in from their dashboard. Attendance Report gives you an overview across the studio and a drill-down per member, with a printable individual report.

📋 GB Registration Page Popup
An auto-shown registration overlay on any page, in three layouts, with a per-class scheduling launcher, profile photo upload, reCAPTCHA, and its own email settings. Paid registration runs through Stripe or Offline Payments.

📅 GB Zoom Integration
Run classes online. A per-slot Online / Offline toggle with Meeting ID, URL and password on each time slot, public class-type badges in your own wording and colours, and a Get Zoom Class Link button on the class page that emails the link on demand.

📈 GB Fitness Tracking
Trainers assign workouts from a template and exercise library, then follow weekly and monthly progress on charts. Body measurements (weight, body fat, muscle mass, waist, chest, hips, biceps, thigh, calf, neck, height, with BMI worked out for you), a daily quick log for water, calories, sleep and steps, a pinned coach feed, and two-way trainer ↔ member chat.

🎨 Pro Add-ons — Building Pages

🎟️ Gym Builder Block Tools
Nine Gutenberg blocks — Classes, Trainers, Class Routine, Slider, Countdown, Call to Action, Info Box, Wrapper and Advanced Heading — plus a Template Importer with six niche-ready templates (Yoga, Fitness, Gym, Boxing, Karate, Swimming) that land as a draft page in one click.

🧩 GB Elementor Widgets
Fourteen Elementor widgets covering every public surface: Hero, Class Card, Class Routine, Class Detail, Trainer Card, Trainer Profile, Trainer Reviews, Pricing Plan, Fitness Calculator, Member Login, Personal Session Booking, Countdown, Testimonial and Meter Ticker. They render the same markup as the matching Gutenberg blocks, so the two stay visually identical.

🖼️ Pre-built Templates
Browse a live catalogue of ready-made Elementor pages for Yoga, Fitness, Gym, Boxing, Karate and Swimming sites and import one as a draft page.

🏃 Yoga Theme
A block theme built to match Gym Builder out of the box.

🛒 Class Booking and Payment
A WooCommerce-based payment route that sends class purchases through Woo checkout. It replaces GB Stripe Payments rather than complementing it — run one or the other, not both.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Gym and fitness centres — track members, set up classes, sell packages
  • Yoga studios — class schedules, instructor profiles, online booking
  • CrossFit boxes — coach assignments, capacity-limited WODs
  • Personal trainers — 1-on-1 session bookings (with GB Personal Session add-on)
  • Boxing and martial arts gyms — recurring memberships, belt-level classes
  • Dance studios — choreographer profiles, class schedules
  • Pilates studios — small-group sessions with capacity tracking
  • Health and wellness clubs — multi-class memberships, member dashboards
  • Sports academies — coach profiles, squad/team scheduling
  • Swimming clubs — coach profiles, junior squad scheduling

Coming Soon

👉 GB Business Manager — money, stock, staff and pay in one place: profit and loss with every add-on’s payments, bills that repeat by themselves, gym equipment and stock, staff clock-in with a PIN kiosk or fingerprint machine, leave, and payroll with payslips.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Gym Builder“
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org
  2. Upload via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or unzip into /wp-content/plugins/gym-builder/ via FTP
  3. Activate through the Plugins menu

After Activation

On a new install the setup wizard opens by itself. Answer a few questions — who the site is for, what you teach, your address and phone, your classes and plans (use the samples or enter your own) — and it builds everything for you: classes with their weekly times, trainers, pricing plans, a Timetable page with registration switched on, and a Pricing page. It takes about a minute, and you can close it at any time.

Prefer to do it by hand?

  1. Go to Gym Builder → Settings to set your currency, time format and pages
  2. Add a class under Classes → Add New and give it its weekly times
  3. Add trainers under Trainers → Add New
  4. Add pricing plans under Membership Package → Add New
  5. Show the timetable with a class shortcode, and pick your Classes and Trainers pages in Settings → Page Settings

The Gym Builder → Dashboard checklist shows what is left to set up.

Demo Content

Want a fast start? Navigate to Gym Builder → Import / Export and import the demo data — you’ll get sample classes, trainers, pricing plans, and a fully styled timetable in seconds.

For one-click niche templates (Yoga, Fitness, Gym, Boxing, Karate, Swimming), use our Pro Gym Builder Block Tools (Gutenberg) or Pre-built Templates (Elementor) add-on.
sections.faq:
Can I use Gym Builder with any theme?

Yes. Gym Builder is theme-agnostic and tested with popular themes including Astra, Hello Elementor, OceanWP, Kadence, GeneratePress, Twenty Twenty-Four, and Twenty Twenty-Five. If you face any issues with your theme, please contact our support and we’ll help.

Does this plugin support multi-language?

Yes, and for seven languages there is nothing for you to do. Gym Builder ships already translated into Italian, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Spanish and Mexican Spanish. Change your site language under Settings → General → Site Language and the whole plugin follows — admin, dashboards, timetable, registration forms, calculators and emails. Every string is covered, including plurals, so “1 place left” and “3 places left” read correctly in each language. Mexican Spanish is a genuine second locale rather than a fallback to Spain, with its own wording (membresía, lugar, credencial) and number formatting. Polish uses all three of its plural forms, so “1 zajęcia”, “3 zajęcia” and “5 zajęć” each read correctly.

The Pro add-ons ship the same seven languages, so payments, bookings, attendance, fitness tracking, promotions, the registration popup, Zoom links, the AI assistant and the Elementor and Gutenberg builders all switch with the site rather than leaving English islands in a translated site.

For any other language, each plugin ships a complete .pot template in its languages/ folder and is WPML-compatible, so you can translate it with Poedit, Loco Translate or WPML. The React admin screens, Elementor controls and block inspectors are translatable too, through WordPress’s script-translation system.

My site is in Italian (or German, French, Dutch, Polish, Spanish) — do I need to translate anything?

No. Set the site language and you are done, for the free plugin and for any Pro add-ons you have installed. If you want to reword something we shipped, copy the matching .po file out of that plugin’s languages/ folder and edit it with Loco Translate or Poedit — saving it to wp-content/languages/plugins/ keeps your wording safe from plugin updates.

Can I still translate Gym Builder into a language you do not ship?

Yes. Point Loco Translate or Poedit at languages/gym-builder.pot, which lists every string in the plugin; each Pro add-on carries its own .pot in the same place. If a language pack for your locale later turns up on translate.wordpress.org, WordPress will load that in preference to anything bundled here, so community translations take over seamlessly.

Can I sell class subscriptions and memberships with this plugin?

The free Gym Builder plugin includes pricing plans, a pricing table shortcode, and free class registration where visitors pick the plan they want. To take payment online, add our Pro GB Stripe Payments add-on (Stripe Checkout with monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, yearly, and one-time billing) or GB Offline Payments (bank transfer, cash, cheque).

Does it support private 1-on-1 personal training bookings?

Yes — with our GB Personal Session add-on. The base plugin handles group classes; the add-on adds 1-on-1 session bookings with calendar-based slot management, Stripe payments, and auto reminders.

Can I add Gym Builder content via Gutenberg blocks?

Yes — with our Pro Gym Builder Block Tools add-on. It adds 9 Gutenberg blocks (Classes, Trainers, Class Routine, Slider, Countdown, CTA, Info Box, Wrapper, Advanced Heading) and a Template Importer with 6 niche-ready templates you can import with one click.

Will member data survive plugin updates?

Yes. Members are stored in a custom database table (wp_gym_builder_members) that’s preserved across plugin updates. The table is only removed if you explicitly uninstall the plugin via WordPress’s uninstall flow.

Can I customize the appearance of the class and trainer pages?

Absolutely. Use the Class Settings and Trainer Settings tabs to change layouts, posts-per-page, and design options. You can also override any template by placing a file at your-theme/gym-builder/<template-file>.php — Gym Builder follows the WooCommerce-style template-override pattern.

Is the plugin GDPR-compliant?

Yes. All member data stays on your WordPress site — nothing is sent to third-party services unless you explicitly install the Stripe, Zoom, or WooCommerce add-ons.

Does Gym Builder support recurring memberships?

Yes, with the GB Stripe Payments add-on. The Stripe add-on supports monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, and yearly recurring billing plus one-time payments. Subscriptions auto-renew, auto-sync member status, and clean up stale states via a daily cron job.

Can my customers book a specific class time slot?

Yes, in the free plugin. Each timetable slot has a Register button showing the places left. Visitors register with their name, email and phone and choose one of the plans that include the class; logged-in members add the class to their membership. With the Pro Stripe or Offline Payments add-on, the chosen plan can be paid for at the same time.

Can visitors register for a class without a paid add-on?

Yes. Free class registration from the timetable is built in: the visitor becomes a pending member with a login, their seat is held, and you activate them from Gym Builder → All Members. You can switch it off under Settings → Class Settings.

Does Gym Builder include a BMI Calculator and other fitness calculators?

Yes — four calculators are built in: BMI, Body Fat percentage, Water Intake, and Protein Intake. Each is embeddable via the [gbfitness_calculator] shortcode.

How do I export my data when migrating to a new site?

Navigate to Gym Builder → Import / Export and export your classes, trainers and pricing plans as a JSON or CSV file. Import on the new site using the same screen.

Is Gym Builder built to WordPress coding standards?

Yes. Under the hood it uses:

  • Modern React 18 + Ant Design 5 admin interfaces
  • Composer-powered PSR-4 autoloading
  • WordPress coding standards
  • REST API endpoints for all data
  • AJAX-driven member CRUD
  • WPCS-compliant PHP, ESLint-clean JavaScript
  • PHP 7.4+ compatible, tested through PHP 8.3
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1

Need help or want to suggest a feature?

For any bug report, support request, or feature suggestion, please submit a ticket here.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Added: One Gym Builder Dashboard for the whole studio: members, the timetable, trainer accounts, every setting and every add-on’s pages, under one menu item, with a search for any page or setting.
  • Improved: The class, trainer, plan and shortcode edit screens are redesigned; add-on settings show on them as cards.
  • Improved: The old admin addresses and bookmarks open the same page in the Dashboard.
  • Note: The add-ons released with 3.0.0 need Gym Builder 3.0.0 or newer. Update Gym Builder first; an add-on stays off with a notice until it is.
  • Added: The setup wizard asks for your studio address and phone number; both are printed on member ID cards and shown to search engines.
  • Improved: Member ID card redesigned — front and back at real card size, with your logo and brand colours, the member’s photo, member ID, plan and dates, a barcode of the member ID, and your address, phone and note. It opens in a preview with a Print button and prints both sides on one page with cut lines.
  • Added: Ready-made translations for Italian, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Spanish and Mexican Spanish — set your site language and the plugin follows, with no translation work.
  • Added: Polish (pl_PL) translation, with all three Polish plural forms, for the free plugin and every Pro add-on.
  • Fixed: Text the admin dashboard loads from the server (the setup checklist, the “needs your attention” list) stayed in the site language for people who use the admin in another language; it now follows each person’s own language.
  • Added: Script translations for the React admin screens, so the dashboard, members and settings pages translate along with the rest.
  • Fixed: Plural strings in the JavaScript screens stayed English in the plural case (“3 days left”); every language now reads correctly at any number.
  • Fixed: The admin dashboard tiles, slot controls and notices were hard-coded English and could not be translated at all.
  • Added: Free class registration from the timetable — Register button with places left, pending member with login, seat held, emails to the member and the gym.
  • Added: Choose a plan with its price when registering; classes no plan covers register without one.
  • Added: Logged-in members add classes from the timetable; a plan they don’t hold becomes a request the gym approves or dismisses.
  • Added: Members can hold several plans; the member dashboard and admin member details list every plan with its dates.
  • Added: Class Settings switch for timetable registration.
  • Improved: Dashboard “Next class” shows the soonest class; “renews” is shown only for plans that renew.
  • Improved: A plan assigned by the gym is kept when a later purchase is made; a member stays active while any plan runs.
  • Improved: Class times match in any format (6:00pm, 06:00 PM, 18:00) for seats and bookings; demo import creates class capacity.
  • Improved: Upsell notices only for admins, on Plugins and the Classes / Trainers / Packages lists, one at a time; review request only after real use.

description:
Gym Builder is the all-in-one WordPress plugin for gym, fitness studio, yoga centre, CrossFit box, and personal training websites. Manage class schedules, trainer profiles, member registrations, pricing packages, fitness calculators, and online bookings — all from a clean WordPress admin, with shortcodes and templates that work with any theme.

👉 Live Demo | Documentation | Get Pro Bundle | Get Pro Add-ons 👈

Whether you teach yoga, run a 24/7 gym, manage a CrossFit box, or coach 1-on-1 personal training, Gym Builder lets you set up your weekly timetable, let visitors register for a class right from the timetable (free — no add-on needed), manage trainers + members, show membership packages, and grow your fitness business — without touching a line of code.

⭐ Why Choose Gym Builder?

  • Ready in about a minute — a short setup wizard asks what you teach, then builds your classes, trainers, pricing plans, a timetable page and a pricing page for you (sample or your own), so you start with a working site instead of an empty one
  • Free class registration — visitors register for a class straight from the timetable, see how many places are left, and pick a plan; no paid add-on needed
  • Built for fitness businesses — every field, taxonomy, and workflow is purpose-built for class/trainer/member operations, not a generic booking plugin
  • Works with any WordPress theme — Astra, Hello Elementor, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Kadence, Twenty Twenty-Four, Twenty Twenty-Five, and most block themes
  • No-code admin — modern React-based dashboards; no developer required
  • Speaks your members’ language out of the box — ready-made translations for Italian, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Spanish and Mexican Spanish, across the free plugin and every Pro add-on; switch your site language and the whole suite follows, with no translation work at all
  • Lightweight & fast — optimized for site performance, minimal frontend asset load
  • GDPR-friendly — member data stays on your site, nothing sent to third parties unless you opt in
  • Theme-overridable templates — override any frontend template by placing a file in your-theme/gym-builder/

🎯 Core Features

🏋️ Class Management

  • Unlimited gym, fitness, or yoga classes via custom post type
  • Class categories with custom taxonomy
  • Weekly schedule with day + time slots + per-slot booking capacity
  • 12-hour or 24-hour time format toggle
  • Class single page + archive page with adjustable layouts
  • Class slider (Swiper-powered with autoplay, effects, pagination, navigation)
  • Multiple class layout shortcodes — grid, slider, routine
  • Class scheduling calendar with visual day/time picker

👨‍🏫 Trainer Management

  • Detailed trainer profiles with bio, skills, qualifications, social links
  • Trainer categories
  • Trainer archive + single pages with layout settings
  • Trainer assignment to classes
  • Trainer Skill Options with progress bars
  • Multiple trainer layout shortcodes

👥 Member Management

  • In-house member database (separate table, not stored in WP users)
  • Add, edit, and delete members from a React-powered admin UI
  • Auto-create WordPress user account + send login credentials by email
  • Printable member ID cards — front and back at real card size, with your logo, brand colours, the member’s photo, plan and dates, and a barcode of the member ID that any USB scanner reads
  • Member status workflow (active / inactive)
  • Membership duration tracking with start/end dates, or no end date for open-ended memberships
  • Members can join several classes, each on its own day and time
  • Members can hold several plans at once — each shown with its dates on their dashboard and in admin
  • Membership renewal reminder emails and automatic lapse when a membership ends
  • “Expiring soon” / “Expired” filters, bulk activate / deactivate / extend, and private staff notes per member
  • Specific-schedule booking from admin and student dashboard
  • Custom user roles — gym_builder_student and gym_builder_trainer

💰 Pricing Plans & Membership Packages

  • Pricing plan custom post type with category taxonomy
  • Pricing tables via the [membership_package_shortcode] with type tabs
  • Per-class pricing info
  • Currency settings — code, symbol, position (left/right)
  • Featured packages and category filtering
  • Package price modifier filter for add-ons

🧮 Fitness Calculators

  • BMI Calculator — body mass index
  • Body Fat Calculator — body fat percentage
  • Water Intake Calculator — daily hydration goal
  • Protein Intake Calculator — daily protein need
  • All four embeddable via [gbfitness_calculator id="123"] shortcode
  • Input field validation built in

👤 User Dashboards

  • Student dashboard — bookings, profile, subscriptions (with add-ons)
  • Trainer dashboard — assigned classes, sessions, and bookings (with add-ons)
  • Both dashboards extensible via tabs from Gym Builder add-on plugins

🔐 Login & Registration

  • Trainer login system
  • Student login system
  • Front-end registration forms
  • Auto-credentials email on member creation

📅 Free Class Registration & Scheduling

  • Register from the timetable — a Register button on every class slot, with “N spots left” or “Class full”
  • Visitors enter name, email and phone and become a pending member with a login; the gym activates them
  • Choose a plan — the plans that include the class are listed with their prices (e.g. “$30 / month”); classes no plan covers register without one
  • Logged-in members add classes to their own membership, within their plan’s classes, class count and end date
  • Picking a plan a member doesn’t hold yet becomes a plan request the gym approves or dismisses
  • Spam protection (nonce, honeypot, time check, rate limits) and confirmation emails to the member and the gym
  • Class times follow your 12/24-hour setting
  • Schedule table layouts
  • Per-slot capacity tracking with race-safe seat booking
  • Seat counts adjust automatically when members are added, edited or deleted

🔄 Export / Import

  • Demo data import for instant site setup
  • Export classes, trainers and pricing plans (JSON or CSV) for migration

🔌 Shortcodes

  • [gbclass id="123"] — class display (grid / slider / routine)
  • [gbtrainer id="123"] — trainer display (multiple layouts)
  • [gbfitness_calculator id="123"] — BMI, body fat, water, protein
  • [membership_package_shortcode] — pricing plans with type tabs

🎨 Theme Compatibility & Styling

  • Override any plugin template via your-theme/gym-builder/ directory (WooCommerce-style)
  • CSS custom properties — --gym-builder-primary-color (default #005dd0), --gym-builder-secondary-color
  • Responsive design optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Compatible with both classic and block themes

🚀 Pro Add-ons & Themes

Everything above is free. When you are ready to take money, track who turns up, or build pages faster, each add-on plugs straight into the classes, plans and members you have already set up — install only the ones you need, or take the whole Pro Bundle. Every add-on below ships the same seven ready-made languages as the free plugin, so adding one never leaves an English patch in a translated site.

🤖 Pro Add-ons — Running the Studio

🤖 GB AI Agent
Run the gym by chatting. Ask it to create a trainer, add a class with its weekly timetable, build a membership package and its class-access rules, enrol or deactivate a member, or free up seats — it checks capacity against the real schedule before it books anything. It configures Stripe for you (keys, billing intervals, prices, and the push to Stripe), assembles a draft Elementor page from section presets or imports a niche template, and pulls reports on the fly: today’s classes, members, expiring memberships, overdue payments, revenue, attendance, personal sessions and workout engagement — exportable as PDF, Word or Excel. It also emails members for you (renewal reminders, or a nudge to the ones who stopped logging workouts), sends you a weekly digest, and answers “how do I…” questions from the family’s own documentation with the exact admin path. Anything destructive asks for confirmation first, nothing changes until you approve it, and every action it takes is listed in an activity log.

Needs WordPress 7.0 or newer — it is built on the WordPress Abilities API and AI Client — plus an AI provider plugin (OpenAI, Anthropic or Google) with your own API key under Settings → AI.

💰 Pro Add-ons — Getting Paid

💳 GB Stripe Payments
Stripe Checkout for your membership packages. Five billing intervals — monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, yearly and one-time — with the buyer choosing their class day and time at checkout and seat capacity checked before the payment goes through. Webhook automation activates the membership the moment payment clears, keeps member status in sync on renewal, failure and cancellation, supports several subscriptions per user, and clears stale states with a daily cron. Subscriptions admin screen with CSV export.

🏦 GB Offline & Manual Payments
Card is not how every studio gets paid. The customer picks “Bank transfer” or “Pay at the studio” at checkout, sees your payment instructions and a reference to quote, and their class place is held while they pay. The order waits in a queue in your admin; when the money arrives you approve it and the membership activates exactly as a card payment would. Covers plans bought from the pricing table, payments recorded by hand at reception, personal session bookings and registrations taken through the popup. Runs alongside GB Stripe Payments, so the same plan can be paid either way.

🎁 GB Promotions & Trials
Coupons, discount codes and free trials for your memberships. Percentage or fixed discounts with usage limits, expiry dates and per-plan targeting, plus an analytics dashboard showing redemptions, discount given, revenue driven and which member used which code. Gateway-neutral by design — Stripe today, with PayPal and Razorpay ready behind a documented interface.

📆 Pro Add-ons — Bookings & Attendance

🗓️ GB Personal Session
One-to-one private training alongside your group classes. Calendar-based slot management with bulk scheduling, a multi-step booking widget (trainer → date → time → details → pay), guest booking with no WordPress account needed, Stripe payment, twice-daily email reminders, refunds at a configurable percentage, trainer reviews with manual or automatic approval, Google Calendar sync, CSV export, and a full status workflow (pending → confirmed → completed, plus cancelled and no-show). Adds its own tabs to both the member and trainer dashboards.

📊 GB Attendance System
Check members in from the admin screen or let them check themselves in from their dashboard. Attendance Report gives you an overview across the studio and a drill-down per member, with a printable individual report.

📋 GB Registration Page Popup
An auto-shown registration overlay on any page, in three layouts, with a per-class scheduling launcher, profile photo upload, reCAPTCHA, and its own email settings. Paid registration runs through Stripe or Offline Payments.

📅 GB Zoom Integration
Run classes online. A per-slot Online / Offline toggle with Meeting ID, URL and password on each time slot, public class-type badges in your own wording and colours, and a Get Zoom Class Link button on the class page that emails the link on demand.

📈 GB Fitness Tracking
Trainers assign workouts from a template and exercise library, then follow weekly and monthly progress on charts. Body measurements (weight, body fat, muscle mass, waist, chest, hips, biceps, thigh, calf, neck, height, with BMI worked out for you), a daily quick log for water, calories, sleep and steps, a pinned coach feed, and two-way trainer ↔ member chat.

🎨 Pro Add-ons — Building Pages

🎟️ Gym Builder Block Tools
Nine Gutenberg blocks — Classes, Trainers, Class Routine, Slider, Countdown, Call to Action, Info Box, Wrapper and Advanced Heading — plus a Template Importer with six niche-ready templates (Yoga, Fitness, Gym, Boxing, Karate, Swimming) that land as a draft page in one click.

🧩 GB Elementor Widgets
Fourteen Elementor widgets covering every public surface: Hero, Class Card, Class Routine, Class Detail, Trainer Card, Trainer Profile, Trainer Reviews, Pricing Plan, Fitness Calculator, Member Login, Personal Session Booking, Countdown, Testimonial and Meter Ticker. They render the same markup as the matching Gutenberg blocks, so the two stay visually identical.

🖼️ Pre-built Templates
Browse a live catalogue of ready-made Elementor pages for Yoga, Fitness, Gym, Boxing, Karate and Swimming sites and import one as a draft page.

🏃 Yoga Theme
A block theme built to match Gym Builder out of the box.

🛒 Class Booking and Payment
A WooCommerce-based payment route that sends class purchases through Woo checkout. It replaces GB Stripe Payments rather than complementing it — run one or the other, not both.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Gym and fitness centres — track members, set up classes, sell packages
  • Yoga studios — class schedules, instructor profiles, online booking
  • CrossFit boxes — coach assignments, capacity-limited WODs
  • Personal trainers — 1-on-1 session bookings (with GB Personal Session add-on)
  • Boxing and martial arts gyms — recurring memberships, belt-level classes
  • Dance studios — choreographer profiles, class schedules
  • Pilates studios — small-group sessions with capacity tracking
  • Health and wellness clubs — multi-class memberships, member dashboards
  • Sports academies — coach profiles, squad/team scheduling
  • Swimming clubs — coach profiles, junior squad scheduling

Coming Soon

👉 GB Business Manager — money, stock, staff and pay in one place: profit and loss with every add-on’s payments, bills that repeat by themselves, gym equipment and stock, staff clock-in with a PIN kiosk or fingerprint machine, leave, and payroll with payslips.
